subject: Q2 close: final commit rollup and invoice coordination
messages:
From: Jane Porter <jane.porter@acmecloud.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-26T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + next steps (Acme Cloud)

Thanks for the demo this morning — we liked the latency numbers and the routing options. Procurement asked for a mutually agreed action plan and a final committed ARR figure by end-of-day Friday so we can get approvals to the board next week.

I've attached a draft SOW and a CSV of our current pipeline (pipeline-rollup-4-26.csv). Can you confirm which opportunities you expect to close this quarter and provide a single-line commit summary (ACV, close date, PO/contract status) by Thursday EOD so we can queue procurement? Also include the invoice timeline if possible.

Thanks,
Jane Porter
Head of Cloud Partnerships
Acme Cloud

Attachments: Acme_SOW_v3.pdf, pipeline-rollup-4-26.csv

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Jane Porter <jane.porter@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-26T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + next steps (Acme Cloud)

Jane — thanks, noted. We'll pull a committed rollup and confirm stages for the deals on your CSV.

Plan: 
- Internal commit sweep today and tomorrow (Ben/Marissa to confirm stage locks).
- I'll send a final one-page commit rollup (PDF) and invoice timing by 9am PDT on April 28.
- Please confirm the procurement contact for PO routing; I see procurement@bigbank.com on one of the lines — confirm which email should receive the invoice/PO.

Quick ask for your procurement team: if you can indicate required billing entity and tax details in reply, that'll speed up DocuSign and invoicing.

I'll attach the internal rollup for your transparency once we lock.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

- ACME-ENT-01 — $320k ACV — Stage: Negotiation/Legal — Recommended: COMMIT (PO expected 4/28)
- ACME-SMB-07 — $45k ACV — Stage: Proposal Sent — Recommended: COMMIT-WATCH (need signed SOW)

-Ben

Date: 2027-04-27T16:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: internal: Acme commit sweep

Ben — good checklist. Please lock stages where sales has explicit PO or signed SOW. Finance cut-off for updates into the Q2 forecast is 2027-04-28 23:59 PT. Anything not ratified by that timestamp will default to next quarter for forecast cadence.

Action items: 
- Ben: update ACME-SMB-07 to COMMIT only if SOW signed and DocuSign completed by Thu EOD; else move to next quarter.
- Soojin: consolidate final dollar amounts and produce a single-line commit rollup PDF for Acme (include invoice timing).
- Lauren: please confirm whether exceptions can be made for partial recognition on ACME-MIGRATE-12 if PO arrives with partial payment terms.

Thanks — I attached a quick rollup workbook for your edits (rollup-20270427.xlsx).
